import unittest
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from datetime import date

PUPIL = Student("1", "Doe", "Jane", "A")

def make_mark(day, status="absent", who="1"):
    return Mark(who, date(2026, 9, day), status)

class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_sorted_absences(self):
        marks = [make_mark(9), make_mark(3)]
        marks.append(make_mark(4, "late"))
        text = absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        want = "Jane Doe missed 2 day(s): "
        want += "2026-09-03, 2026-09-09."
        self.assertEqual(text, want)

    def test_other_student(self):
        marks = [make_mark(3), make_mark(4, who="2")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, [make_mark(3, "present")])
